faqs.q: Can you repair my dishwasher the same day?
faqs.a: Yes. Same-day dishwasher repair is available in Houston and nearby cities. Reach us by phone or through the online form and we will set up a visit for the same day.

faqs.q: Why does my dishwasher leave water at the bottom?
faqs.a: A clogged filter or drain hose, a jammed drain pump or a blocked garbage disposal connection are the usual causes. Cleaning the filter is a safe first check.

faqs.q: Why are my dishes still dirty after a cycle?
faqs.a: Blocked spray arms, a clogged filter, low water fill or a weak wash pump. Water that isn’t hot enough also hurts cleaning.

faqs.q: Why are my dishes still wet at the end?
faqs.a: Check the rinse aid first. If it is full, the heating element, a thermostat or the drying fan may have failed.

faqs.q: Do you repair Bosch and other European dishwashers?
faqs.a: Yes. We repair all major brands, including Bosch, Thermador, KitchenAid, Whirlpool, GE, Samsung and LG.

faqs.q: Do I pay for the diagnosis?
faqs.a: No. The estimate is free: you learn the cause and the repair price before any work, and you choose whether to continue.

faqs.q: What warranty do dishwasher repairs have?
faqs.a: Dishwasher repairs are covered by our 90-day warranty on parts and labor.
